description: Defines the IFirmwareUpdate interface for firmware update operations, including states, notifications, and control methods within the WPEFramework::Exchange namespace.

classes.name: IFirmwareUpdate
classes.description: Interface for firmware update operations, including state management, notifications, and control functions.

classes.name: IFirmwareUpdate::Result
classes.description: Structure indicating success or failure of firmware update.

classes.name: IFirmwareUpdate::GetUpdateStateResult
classes.description: Structure providing current update state and substate.

classes.name: IFirmwareUpdate::INotification
classes.description: Notification interface for firmware update events such as state changes and flashing progress.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for firmware update events.

methods.name: UpdateFirmware
methods.description: Initiates a firmware update with specified file path and type.

methods.name: GetUpdateState
methods.description: Retrieves the current firmware update state and substate.

methods.name: SetAutoReboot
methods.description: Enables or disables auto-reboot after firmware update.
